# Third-party notices

Nothing here is built. CMake fetches Catch2 and CLI11 at the versions pinned in
`cmake/ThirdParty.cmake`, or uses a system package where one is installed.

What stays is the licence text each dependency asks to travel with binaries
that include it. `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md` in the repository root is assembled
from these and is what the `.deb` and the standalone downloads carry.
